remarks:
Welcome to 75 Henel Ave, Unit 3, located in the desirable Cloister Square Condominiums! This inviting first-floor unit offers comfortable and convenient low maintenance living with two spacious bedrooms and two full, updated bathrooms. The open living and dining area features beautiful hardwood floors and plenty of natural light. Sliding glass doors lead to a covered porch, creating a wonderful extension of the living space and the perfect spot to relax or entertain while overlooking the community pool and courtyard. Additional conveniences include on-site laundry with a dedicated washer and dryer for unit 3 included. Generous walk-in closets provide ample storage. In addition, store other items in the dedicated basement storage space for unit 3.

Enjoy the convenience of being situated near shopping, dining, and activities / entertainment all within walking distance of the Cloister Square Condominiums. Offering a combination of move-in-ready indoor comfort, low-maintenance outdoor living space, ample storage, and a convenient first-floor location, this condo provides an opportunity to enjoy Amherst living just minutes from the University at Buffalo. Open House to be held Thursday, October 8 from 5-7 PM.
